It has no blob oid and no sha256.\n2. code:run has no `crypto` global. The cause is one log line: '[with-test-pg] evidence preflight failed: PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUNS_DB_URL is required for durable isolated test receipts' (scripts/with-test-pg.mjs ~L58). That preflight fires whenever PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_RECEIPT_FILE or PC_EXECUTED_SOURCE_MAP_RESULT is set, and mutation-probe sets one of them. A capability:bash shell does not export PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUNS_DB_URL, and the same command worked for su-055e916b on 2026-10-10. The verdict only says harness-error. Workaround: export PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUNS_DB_URL to the shared ledger (the same default as scripts/run-operator-e2e-isolated.sh). Suggested fix: mutation-probe.sh should preflight this before the baseline when --test runs 'with-test-pg --isolated-runtime' and name the env var in its refusal. Alternatively, the 'Proving a guard is falsifiable' docs should state the requirement.
